observations.what: Page sample of nbapd, card C009 (Homecare Software Solutions LLC term loan, 2025-12-31) marked basis_spread 5.56 wrong/pipeline against the printed 'S + 263 Cash plus 2.93 % PIK'. 5.56 = 2.63 cash + 2.93 PIK margin with pik_rate 2.93 published separately: the owner convention D-031 (spread = cash + PIK margin, pik_rate separate; interest_rate storage is the cash leg). Not a data error; no data changed. observations.suggested_check: Add D-031 to the page-sample reader brief: a card where basis_spread equals the printed cash margin plus the printed PIK margin and pik_rate equals the PIK margin is graded 'convention', not 'wrong'.
